Not only implicated in synaptic inhibition but also in hippocampal long-term potentiation, slow wave sleep, muscle relaxation and antinociception (By similarity). Interacts with KCTD8, KCTD12 and KCTD16; this interaction determines the pharmacology and kinetics of the receptor response, the KCTD proteins markedly accelerating the GABA-B response, although to different extents (PubMed:20400944)

The relaxase completes DNA transfer by reversing the covalent phosphotyrosine linkage, presumably recircularizing and releasing the plasmid DNA
